[quote=sal-baliz;59285226][spoiler=[b]The Great Jihad - Part 3[/b]
[i]In the shadows of despair, our blind devotion to faith transforms fear into a reckless courage that leads us to destruction[/i]]
Sand churns up from the ground underneath the armoured vehicles as they speed towards the holy city. A renewed urge to fight has been instilled in the soldiers, almost as if the very presence of Mecca is affected them. The soldiers are no longer afraid of the Hydronians and their allies, they have a sense of hatred towards them. No longer will they hide and cower whenever a helicopter passes by, they will stand up and shout and cheer, firing their machine guns into the sky.
"Down with Hydronia!" they shout, "Down with Hydronia!"

12 hours had passed since the unit set off when they arrived at a large hill made of sand. Abd ordered them to begin setting up camp there. The soldiers jumped out of their vehicles and began setting up various pieces of military equipment as instructed. One soldier was curious enough to peek over the edge of the hill and what he saw was unexpected. Around 2km from the hill lay a sprawling urban area, Mecca. This in itself was not unexpected and was in fact a sight to behold for the soldier, but what encircled it was not. A huge perimeter of soldiers, Hydronian, bobian and indonocaismnican. Luckily he went unnoticed by the army that lay before him, but the realisation set in that he would have to face them soon.After all of the equipment had been set up, Abd stood atop the hill, just low enough so he wouldn't be spotted by the snipers below.

"Listen up, Listen up! Today is a great day for our people, but not just our people, for all muslims of Erene! Today is the day that Mecca finally returns to the hands of those who rightfully deserve it, those who follow Allah's every wish and those who dedicate their lives to the greatness of Islam! We may be outnumbered, we may be outskilled, but we are not outplayed in our devotion and faith! We live to serve Allah and he will give us power! Follow me my brothers and let Allah lead us to victory! Long live Islam! Long live the Jihad! Allahu Akbar!"

As he spoke the final words of his speech, he climbed to the top of the hill and raised his gun high, signalling for the others to follow. They chanted Abd's words in perfect unison as they charged down the hill, ready to face whatever lay below...
